### **Part 1: Basic Forest Fire Model**

```{r}
# ----------------------------
# 1️⃣ 加载库
# ----------------------------
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(gganimate)

# ----------------------------
# 2️⃣ 参数与网格初始化
# ----------------------------
N <- 100          # 网格大小
alpha <- 0.5      # 感染概率
beta <- 0.1       # 烧尽概率
timesteps <- 50   # 模拟步数

# 状态编码：2=易燃，1=着火，0=烧尽
X <- matrix(2, nrow=N, ncol=N)

# 多起火源（中心附近5个格子随机着火）
set.seed(42)
center <- N %/% 2
fire_indices <- expand.grid(x=(center-1):(center+1), y=(center-1):(center+1))
fire_indices <- fire_indices[sample(1:nrow(fire_indices), 5), ]
for(k in 1:nrow(fire_indices)){
  X[fire_indices$x[k], fire_indices$y[k]] <- 1
}

# ----------------------------
# 3️⃣ 八邻居函数
# ----------------------------
get_neighbors <- function(i,j,N){
  neighbors <- expand.grid(x=(i-1):(i+1), y=(j-1):(j+1))
  neighbors <- neighbors[!(neighbors$x==i & neighbors$y==j), ]
  neighbors <- neighbors[neighbors$x>=1 & neighbors$x<=N &
                         neighbors$y>=1 & neighbors$y<=N, ]
  return(as.matrix(neighbors))
}

# ----------------------------
# 4️⃣ 火灾传播函数
# ----------------------------
spread_fire <- function(X, alpha, beta){
  N <- nrow(X)
  X_new <- X
  for(i in 1:N){
    for(j in 1:N){
      if(X[i,j]==1){  # infected
        neighbors <- get_neighbors(i,j,N)
        for(k in 1:nrow(neighbors)){
          ni <- neighbors[k,1]
          nj <- neighbors[k,2]
          if(X[ni,nj]==2){  # susceptible neighbor
            if(runif(1)<alpha){
              X_new[ni,nj] <- 1
            }
          }
        }
        if(runif(1)<beta){  # infected becomes removed
          X_new[i,j] <- 0
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return(X_new)
}

# ----------------------------
# 5️⃣ 记录每步状态用于动画
# ----------------------------
X_list <- list()
X_list[[1]] <- X
for(t in 2:timesteps){
  X <- spread_fire(X, alpha, beta)
  X_list[[t]] <- X
}

# ----------------------------
# 6️⃣ 转为动画数据框
# ----------------------------
df_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:timesteps, function(t){
  df <- melt(X_list[[t]])
  df$time <- t
  df
}))

# ----------------------------
# 7️⃣ 绘制动态动画
# ----------------------------
p <- ggplot(df_all, aes(x=Var2, y=Var1, fill=factor(value))) +
  geom_tile(color="grey") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("black","red","green"),
                    labels=c("Removed","Infected","Susceptible")) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text=element_blank(),
        axis.title=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks=element_blank()) +
  labs(fill="State") +
  transition_time(time) +
  ggtitle('Time step: {frame_time}')

animate(p, nframes=timesteps, fps=1, width=600, height=600)
```

```{r}
# ----------------------------
# 3️⃣ Part 1b & 1c: 参数探索
# ----------------------------
alphas <- c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7)
betas <- c(0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3)
results <- expand.grid(alpha=alphas, beta=betas)
results$final_burned <- NA

set.seed(123)
for(i in 1:nrow(results)){
  a <- results$alpha[i]
  b <- results$beta[i]
  X <- matrix(2, N, N)
  fire_indices <- expand.grid(x=(center-1):(center+1), y=(center-1):(center+1))
  fire_indices <- fire_indices[sample(1:nrow(fire_indices), 5), ]
  for(k in 1:nrow(fire_indices)) X[fire_indices$x[k], fire_indices$y[k]] <- 1
  for(t in 1:timesteps){
    X <- spread_fire(X, a, b)
  }
  results$final_burned[i] <- sum(X==0) / (N*N)  # 烧尽比例
}

print(results)

# ----------------------------
# 热力图可视化最终烧尽比例（Part 1c）
# ----------------------------
ggplot(results, aes(x=factor(alpha), y=factor(beta), fill=final_burned)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low="white", high="red") +
  labs(title="Final Burned Proportion by alpha/beta",
       x="Infection Probability (alpha)",
       y="Removal Probability (beta)",
       fill="Burned Proportion") +
  theme_minimal()

alpha_beta_results <- results
```

### **Part 2: Enhanced Forest Fire Model**

$$
p = \frac{1}{1 + \exp\Big(- \big( \text{logit}(\alpha) + \gamma \, w \, \cos\theta + \delta \, w \big) \Big)} 
$$

Wind Strength

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# ----------------------------
# 参数设置
# ----------------------------
N <- 25
timesteps <- 5
alpha <- 0.3
beta <- 0.1
wind_dx <- 1
wind_dy <- 0
gamma <- 0.1
delta <- 0.05
max_wind_range <- 6
center <- N %/% 2
wind_values <- c(0, 50, 100)
num_simulations <- 50  # 设置模拟次数

# ----------------------------
# 生成邻居偏移函数
# ----------------------------
generate_neighbors <- function(w){
  offsets <- expand.grid(dx=-1:1, dy=-1:1)
  offsets <- offsets[!(offsets$dx==0 & offsets$dy==0), ]
  r_max <- min(max_wind_range, 1 + ceiling(w/20))
  for(r in 2:r_max){
    offsets <- rbind(offsets, data.frame(dx=r*wind_dx, dy=r*wind_dy))
  }
  return(offsets)
}

# ----------------------------
# 火灾传播函数
# ----------------------------
spread_fire_wind <- function(X, alpha, beta, w){
  N <- nrow(X)
  X_new <- X
  logit_alpha <- log(alpha/(1-alpha))
  neighbor_offsets <- generate_neighbors(w)
  
  for(i in 1:N){
    for(j in 1:N){
      if(X[i,j]==1){
        for(n_idx in seq_len(nrow(neighbor_offsets))){
          ni <- i + neighbor_offsets$dx[n_idx]
          nj <- j + neighbor_offsets$dy[n_idx]
          if(ni>=1 && ni<=N && nj>=1 && nj<=N && X[ni,nj]==2){
            dx <- ni - i
            dy <- nj - j
            dot <- dx*wind_dx + dy*wind_dy
            norm <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2) * sqrt(wind_dx^2 + wind_dy^2)
            cos_theta <- if(norm==0) 0 else dot/norm
            prob <- 1/(1 + exp(-(logit_alpha + gamma*w*cos_theta + delta*w)))
            if(runif(1)<prob) X_new[ni,nj] <- 1
          }
        }
        if(runif(1)<beta) X_new[i,j] <- 0
      }
    }
  }
  return(X_new)
}

# ----------------------------
# 模拟并整理数据
# ----------------------------
df_all <- data.frame()
burned_summary <- data.frame()
all_burned_ratios <- data.frame()  # 用来存储每次模拟的烧毁比例

# 记录每个风速下的平均焚烧比例
for(w in wind_values){
  burned_ratios <- numeric(num_simulations)  # 存储每次模拟的烧毁比例
  
  for(sim in 1:num_simulations){  # 多次模拟
    X <- matrix(2,N,N)
    fire_indices <- expand.grid(x=(center-1):(center+1), y=(center-1):(center+1))
    for(k_idx in seq_len(nrow(fire_indices))) X[fire_indices$x[k_idx], fire_indices$y[k_idx]] <- 1
    
    for(t in 1:timesteps){
      X <- spread_fire_wind(X, alpha, beta, w)
    }
    
    # 记录每次模拟的烧毁比例
    burned_ratios[sim] <- sum(X==0)/(N*N)
    
    # 只记录一次模拟结果（选取第一个模拟结果）
    if(sim == 1){
      df <- expand.grid(x=1:N, y=1:N)
      df$state <- as.factor(as.vector(X))
      df$wind <- paste0("Wind=", w, " (E)")  # 标题里显示风向
      df_all <- rbind(df_all, df)
    }
  }
  
  # 计算每个风速的平均焚烧比例
  avg_burned_ratio <- mean(burned_ratios)
  burned_summary <- rbind(burned_summary, data.frame(wind=w, burned=avg_burned_ratio))
  
  # 保存所有模拟的焚烧比例
  all_burned_ratios <- rbind(all_burned_ratios, data.frame(wind=rep(w, num_simulations), burned=burned_ratios))
}

# ----------------------------
# 网格图（只展示一个模拟结果）
# ----------------------------
ggplot(df_all, aes(x=x, y=y, fill=state)) +
  geom_tile(color="gray") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("black","red","green")) +
  facet_wrap(~wind, ncol=3) +  # 展示不同风速下的火灾传播
  labs(title="Forest Fire Simulation with Different Wind Strengths (Wind Direction: E)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme(axis.text=element_blank(), axis.ticks=element_blank(),
        strip.text=element_text(size=12))

# ----------------------------
# 条形图显示每个风速的平均焚烧比例
# ----------------------------
ggplot(burned_summary, aes(x=factor(wind), y=burned, fill=factor(wind))) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", color="black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("lightblue","orange","red")) +
  labs(title="Average Burned Area vs Wind Strength",
       x="Wind Strength",
       y="Average Burned Ratio") +
  theme_minimal()

# ----------------------------
# 箱型图展示每个风速下焚烧比例的分布情况
# ----------------------------
ggplot(all_burned_ratios, aes(x=factor(wind), y=burned, fill=factor(wind))) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = "red", outlier.size = 2) +  # 高亮显示异常值
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("lightblue", "orange", "red")) +  # 设置颜色
  labs(title="Burned Area Distribution vs Wind Strength",
       x="Wind Strength",
       y="Burned Ratio") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12), axis.title=element_text(size=14),
        strip.text=element_text(size=12), legend.position="none")

# ----------------------------
# 折线图展示每个风速下每次模拟的焚烧比例
# ----------------------------
ggplot(all_burned_ratios, aes(x=seq_along(burned), y=burned, group=wind, color=factor(wind))) +
  geom_line(alpha=0.5) +
  labs(title="Burned Area per Simulation vs Wind Strength",
       x="Simulation Number",
       y="Burned Ratio") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("lightblue", "orange", "red")) +
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12), axis.title=element_text(size=14))

# ----------------------------
# 保存数据
# ----------------------------
burned_summary_wind <- burned_summary

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# ----------------------------
# 参数设置
# ----------------------------
N <- 25
timesteps <- 5
alpha_values <- c(0.2, 0.3, 0.4)  # 使用 3 个 alpha 值
beta_values <- c(0.1, 0.2, 0.3)   # 使用 3 个 beta 值
wind_dx <- 1
wind_dy <- 0
gamma <- 0.1
delta <- 0.05
max_wind_range <- 6
center <- N %/% 2
wind_values <- c(0, 50, 100)  # 风速 0, 50, 100
num_simulations <- 50  # 设置模拟次数

# ----------------------------
# 生成邻居偏移函数
# ----------------------------
generate_neighbors <- function(w){
  offsets <- expand.grid(dx=-1:1, dy=-1:1)
  offsets <- offsets[!(offsets$dx==0 & offsets$dy==0), ]
  r_max <- min(max_wind_range, 1 + ceiling(w/20))
  for(r in 2:r_max){
    offsets <- rbind(offsets, data.frame(dx=r*wind_dx, dy=r*wind_dy))
  }
  return(offsets)
}

# ----------------------------
# 火灾传播函数
# ----------------------------
spread_fire_wind <- function(X, alpha, beta, w){
  N <- nrow(X)
  X_new <- X
  logit_alpha <- log(alpha/(1-alpha))
  neighbor_offsets <- generate_neighbors(w)
  
  for(i in 1:N){
    for(j in 1:N){
      if(X[i,j]==1){
        for(n_idx in seq_len(nrow(neighbor_offsets))){
          ni <- i + neighbor_offsets$dx[n_idx]
          nj <- j + neighbor_offsets$dy[n_idx]
          if(ni>=1 && ni<=N && nj>=1 && nj<=N && X[ni,nj]==2){
            dx <- ni - i
            dy <- nj - j
            dot <- dx*wind_dx + dy*wind_dy
            norm <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2) * sqrt(wind_dx^2 + wind_dy^2)
            cos_theta <- if(norm==0) 0 else dot/norm
            prob <- 1/(1 + exp(-(logit_alpha + gamma*w*cos_theta + delta*w)))
            if(runif(1)<prob) X_new[ni,nj] <- 1
          }
        }
        if(runif(1)<beta) X_new[i,j] <- 0
      }
    }
  }
  return(X_new)
}

# ----------------------------
# 模拟并整理数据
# ----------------------------
df_all <- data.frame()
burned_summary <- data.frame()
all_burned_ratios <- data.frame()  # 用来存储每次模拟的烧毁比例

# 记录每个风速下的平均焚烧比例
for(w in wind_values){
  for(alpha in alpha_values){   # 新增不同的 alpha 和 beta 组合
    for(beta in beta_values){
      burned_ratios <- numeric(num_simulations)  # 存储每次模拟的烧毁比例
      
      for(sim in 1:num_simulations){  # 多次模拟
        X <- matrix(2, N, N)
        fire_indices <- expand.grid(x=(center-1):(center+1), y=(center-1):(center+1))
        for(k_idx in seq_len(nrow(fire_indices))) X[fire_indices$x[k_idx], fire_indices$y[k_idx]] <- 1
        
        for(t in 1:timesteps){
          X <- spread_fire_wind(X, alpha, beta, w)
        }
        
        # 记录每次模拟的烧毁比例
        burned_ratios[sim] <- sum(X==0)/(N*N)
        
        # 只记录一次模拟结果（选取第一个模拟结果）
        if(sim == 1){
          df <- expand.grid(x=1:N, y=1:N)
          df$state <- as.factor(as.vector(X))
          df$wind <- paste0("Wind=", w, " (E)")  # 标题里显示风向
          df$alpha <- alpha  # 添加 alpha
          df$beta <- beta     # 添加 beta
          df_all <- rbind(df_all, df)
        }
      }
      
      # 计算每个风速的平均焚烧比例
      avg_burned_ratio <- mean(burned_ratios)
      burned_summary <- rbind(burned_summary, data.frame(wind=w, alpha=alpha, beta=beta, burned=avg_burned_ratio))
      
      # 保存所有模拟的焚烧比例
      all_burned_ratios <- rbind(all_burned_ratios, data.frame(wind=rep(w, num_simulations), alpha=rep(alpha, num_simulations), beta=rep(beta, num_simulations), burned=burned_ratios))
    }
  }
}

# ----------------------------
# 颜色设置，提供 9 种颜色
# ----------------------------
color_palette <- c("lightblue", "orange", "red", "green", "purple", "yellow", "pink", "lightgreen", "cyan")

# ----------------------------
# 生成柱状图展示不同风力下每个组合的焚烧比例
# ----------------------------
ggplot(burned_summary, aes(x=factor(wind), y=burned, fill=factor(interaction(alpha, beta)))) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", color="black", position="dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=color_palette) +  # 使用手动指定的 9 种颜色
  labs(title="Average Burned Area vs Wind Strength with Different Alpha and Beta Combinations",
       x="Wind Strength",
       y="Average Burned Ratio") +
  theme_minimal()

# ----------------------------
# 生成箱型图展示每个风速下焚烧比例的分布情况（包括 alpha 和 beta 组合）
# ----------------------------
ggplot(all_burned_ratios, aes(x=factor(wind), y=burned, fill=factor(interaction(alpha, beta)))) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = "red", outlier.size = 2) +  # 高亮显示异常值
  scale_fill_manual(values=color_palette) +  # 使用手动指定的 9 种颜色
  labs(title="Burned Area Distribution vs Wind Strength with Different Alpha and Beta Combinations",
       x="Wind Strength",
       y="Burned Ratio") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12), axis.title=element_text(size=14),
        strip.text=element_text(size=12), legend.position="none")

# ----------------------------
# 生成折线图展示每个风速下每次模拟的焚烧比例（包括 alpha 和 beta 组合）
# ----------------------------
ggplot(all_burned_ratios, aes(x=seq_along(burned), y=burned, group=interaction(wind, alpha, beta), color=factor(interaction(alpha, beta)))) +
  geom_line(alpha=0.5) +
  labs(title="Burned Area per Simulation vs Wind Strength with Different Alpha and Beta Combinations",
       x="Simulation Number",
       y="Burned Ratio") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values=color_palette) +  # 使用手动指定的 9 种颜色
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12), axis.title=element_text(size=14))

```

Wind Direction

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# ----------------------------
# 参数设置
# ----------------------------
N <- 25
timesteps <- 5
alpha <- 0.3
beta <- 0.1
wind_strength <- 50  # 固定风力
gamma <- 0.1
delta <- 0.05
max_wind_range <- 6
center <- N %/% 2
num_simulations <- 50  # 设置模拟次数

# ----------------------------
# 正确的风向向量（ggplot 坐标系：y 向上 = 北）
# ----------------------------
wind_list <- list(
  E  = c(1, 0),     # 东：向右
  W  = c(-1, 0),    # 西：向左
  N  = c(0, 1),     # 北：向上
  S  = c(0, -1),    # 南：向下
  NE = c(1, 1),     # 东北：右上
  NW = c(-1, 1),    # 西北：左上
  SE = c(1, -1),    # 东南：右下
  SW = c(-1, -1)    # 西南：左下
)

# ----------------------------
# 生成邻居偏移函数
# ----------------------------
generate_neighbors <- function(w, wind_dx, wind_dy){
  offsets <- expand.grid(dx=-1:1, dy=-1:1)
  offsets <- offsets[!(offsets$dx==0 & offsets$dy==0), ]
  r_max <- min(max_wind_range, 1 + ceiling(w/20))
  for(r in 2:r_max){
    offsets <- rbind(offsets, data.frame(dx=r*wind_dx, dy=r*wind_dy))
  }
  offsets
}

# ----------------------------
# 火灾传播函数
# ----------------------------
spread_fire_wind <- function(X, alpha, beta, w, wind_dx, wind_dy){
  N <- nrow(X)
  X_new <- X
  logit_alpha <- log(alpha/(1-alpha))
  neighbor_offsets <- generate_neighbors(w, wind_dx, wind_dy)
  
  for(i in 1:N){
    for(j in 1:N){
      if(X[i,j]==1){
        for(n_idx in seq_len(nrow(neighbor_offsets))){
          ni <- i + neighbor_offsets$dx[n_idx]
          nj <- j + neighbor_offsets$dy[n_idx]
          if(ni>=1 && ni<=N && nj>=1 && nj<=N && X[ni,nj]==2){
            dx <- ni - i
            dy <- nj - j
            dot <- dx*wind_dx + dy*wind_dy
            norm <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2) * sqrt(wind_dx^2 + wind_dy^2)
            cos_theta <- if(norm==0) 0 else dot/norm
            prob <- 1/(1 + exp(-(logit_alpha + gamma*w*cos_theta + delta*w)))
            if(runif(1)<prob) X_new[ni,nj] <- 1
          }
        }
        if(runif(1)<beta) X_new[i,j] <- 0
      }
    }
  }
  X_new
}

# ----------------------------
# 模拟所有风向
# ----------------------------
df_all <- data.frame()
burned_summary <- data.frame()
all_burned_ratios <- data.frame()  # 用来存储每次模拟的烧毁比例

for(name in names(wind_list)){
  wind_vec <- wind_list[[name]]
  
  burned_ratios <- numeric(num_simulations)  # 存储每次模拟的烧毁比例
  
  for(sim in 1:num_simulations){  # 多次模拟
    X <- matrix(2,N,N)
    fire_indices <- expand.grid(x=(center-1):(center+1), y=(center-1):(center+1))
    for(k_idx in seq_len(nrow(fire_indices))) X[fire_indices$x[k_idx], fire_indices$y[k_idx]] <- 1
    
    for(t in 1:timesteps){
      X <- spread_fire_wind(X, alpha, beta, wind_strength, wind_vec[1], wind_vec[2])
    }
    
    # 记录每次模拟的烧毁比例
    burned_ratios[sim] <- sum(X==0)/(N*N)
    
    # 只记录一次模拟结果（选取第一个模拟结果）
    if(sim == 1){
      df <- expand.grid(x=1:N, y=1:N)
      df$state <- as.factor(as.vector(X))
      df$wind <- paste0("Wind: ", name)
      df_all <- rbind(df_all, df)
    }
  }
  
  # 计算每个风向的平均焚烧比例
  avg_burned_ratio <- mean(burned_ratios)
  burned_summary <- rbind(burned_summary, data.frame(wind=name, burned=avg_burned_ratio))
  
  # 保存所有模拟的焚烧比例
  all_burned_ratios <- rbind(all_burned_ratios, data.frame(wind=rep(name, num_simulations), burned=burned_ratios))
}

# ----------------------------
# 网格图（火灾分布）
# ----------------------------
ggplot(df_all, aes(x=x, y=y, fill=state)) +
  geom_tile(color="gray") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("black","red","green")) +
  facet_wrap(~wind, ncol=4) +
  labs(title="Forest Fire Simulation (Correct Wind Directions)",
       x=NULL, y=NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme(axis.text=element_blank(), axis.ticks=element_blank(),
        strip.text=element_text(size=12))

# ----------------------------
# 烧毁面积条形图
# ----------------------------
ggplot(burned_summary, aes(x=factor(wind), y=burned, fill=factor(wind))) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", color="black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("lightblue","orange","red","purple","pink","brown","yellow","green")) +
  labs(title="Burned Area Ratio by Wind Direction",
       x="Wind Direction", y="Burned Ratio") +
  theme_minimal()

# ----------------------------
# 箱型图展示每个风速下焚烧比例的分布情况
# ----------------------------
ggplot(all_burned_ratios, aes(x=factor(wind), y=burned, fill=factor(wind))) +
```

Ember

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# ----------------------------
# 参数设置
# ----------------------------
N <- 60
timesteps <- 7
alpha <- 0.3
beta <- 0.1
wind_strength <- 50
wind_dx <- 1
wind_dy <- 0
gamma <- 0.1
delta <- 0.05
max_wind_range <- 6
center <- N %/% 2
num_simulations <- 50  # 设置模拟次数

# ----------------------------
# 生成邻居偏移函数
# ----------------------------
generate_neighbors <- function(w, wind_dx, wind_dy) {
  offsets <- expand.grid(dx = -1:1, dy = -1:1)
  offsets <- offsets[!(offsets$dx == 0 & offsets$dy == 0), ]
  
  r_max <- min(max_wind_range, 1 + ceiling(w / 20))
  for (r in 2:r_max) {
    offsets <- rbind(offsets, data.frame(dx = r * wind_dx, dy = r * wind_dy))
  }
  offsets
}

# ----------------------------
# 火灾传播函数（可控制 ember）
# ----------------------------
spread_fire <- function(X, alpha, beta, w, wind_dx, wind_dy, ember = TRUE) {
  N <- nrow(X)
  X_new <- X
  logit_alpha <- log(alpha / (1 - alpha))
  neighbor_offsets <- generate_neighbors(w, wind_dx, wind_dy)
  
  for (i in 1:N) {
    for (j in 1:N) {
      if (X[i, j] == 1) {  # 普通蔓延
        for (n_idx in seq_len(nrow(neighbor_offsets))) {
          ni <- i + neighbor_offsets$dx[n_idx]
          nj <- j + neighbor_offsets$dy[n_idx]
          
          if (ni >= 1 && ni <= N && nj >= 1 && nj <= N && X[ni, nj] == 2) {
            dx <- ni - i
            dy <- nj - j
            dot <- dx * wind_dx + dy * wind_dy
            norm <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2) * sqrt(wind_dx^2 + wind_dy^2)
            cos_theta <- ifelse(norm == 0, 0, dot / norm)
            prob <- 1 / (1 + exp(-(logit_alpha + gamma * w * cos_theta + delta * w)))
            if (runif(1) < prob) X_new[ni, nj] <- 1
          }
        }
        
        # 生成远程火星
        if (ember) {  # 随机远程火点，距离 up to 3 格子
          r_ember <- sample(2:3, 1)
          ni <- i + r_ember * wind_dx
          nj <- j + r_ember * wind_dy
          if (ni >= 1 && ni <= N && nj >= 1 && nj <= N && X_new[ni, nj] == 2) {
            X_new[ni, nj] <- 1
          }
        }
        
        # 原火熄灭概率
        if (runif(1) < beta) X_new[i, j] <- 0
      }
    }
  }
  
  X_new
}

# ----------------------------
# 模拟有/无 ember
# ----------------------------
scenarios <- c("No Ember", "With Ember")
df_all <- data.frame()
burned_summary <- data.frame()
all_burned_ratios <- data.frame()  # 用来存储每次模拟的烧毁比例

for (scenario in scenarios) {
  burned_ratios <- numeric(num_simulations)  # 存储每次模拟的烧毁比例
  
  for (sim in 1:num_simulations) {
    # 多次模拟
    X <- matrix(2, N, N)
    fire_indices <- expand.grid(x = (center - 1):(center + 1), y = (center - 1):(center + 1))
    
    for (k_idx in seq_len(nrow(fire_indices))) {
      X[fire_indices$x[k_idx], fire_indices$y[k_idx]] <- 1
    }
    
    for (t in 1:timesteps) {
      X <- spread_fire(X, alpha, beta, wind_strength, wind_dx, wind_dy, ember = (scenario == "With Ember"))
    }
    
    # 记录每次模拟的烧毁比例
    burned_ratios[sim] <- sum(X == 0) / (N * N)
    
    # 只记录一次模拟结果（选取第一个模拟结果）
    if (sim == 1) {
      df <- expand.grid(x = 1:N, y = 1:N)
      df$state <- as.factor(as.vector(X))
      df$scenario <- scenario
      df_all <- rbind(df_all, df)
    }
  }
  
  # 计算每个场景的平均焚烧比例
  avg_burned_ratio <- mean(burned_ratios)
  burned_summary <- rbind(burned_summary, data.frame(scenario = scenario, burned = avg_burned_ratio))
  
  # 保存所有模拟的焚烧比例
  all_burned_ratios <- rbind(all_burned_ratios, data.frame(scenario = rep(scenario, num_simulations), burned = burned_ratios))
}

# ----------------------------
# 网格图
# ----------------------------
ggplot(df_all, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = state)) +
  geom_tile(color = "gray") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("black", "red", "green")) +

ggplot(all_burned_ratios, aes(x = factor(scenario), y = burned, fill = factor(scenario))) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("lightblue", "orange")) +  # 设置颜色

# ----------------------------
```

```{r}
generate_neighbors <- function(w, wind_dx, wind_dy){

  }

# ----------------------------
# 火灾传播函数（可控制 ember）
# ----------------------------
spread_fire <- function(X, alpha, beta, w, wind_dx, wind_dy, ember=TRUE){
  N <- nrow(X)
  X_new <- X
  logit_alpha <- log(alpha/(1-alpha))
  neighbor_offsets <- generate_neighbors(w, wind_dx, wind_dy)
  
  for(i in 1:N){
    for(j in 1:N){
      if(X[i,j]==1){
        # 普通蔓延
        for(n_idx in seq_len(nrow(neighbor_offsets))){
          ni <- i + neighbor_offsets$dx[n_idx]
          nj <- j + neighbor_offsets$dy[n_idx]
          if(ni>=1 && ni<=N && nj>=1 && nj<=N && X[ni,nj]==2){
            dx <- ni - i
            dy <- nj - j
            dot <- dx*wind_dx + dy*wind_dy
            norm <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2) * sqrt(wind_dx^2 + wind_dy^2)
            cos_theta <- if(norm==0) 0 else dot/norm
            prob <- 1/(1 + exp(-(logit_alpha + gamma*w*cos_theta + delta*w)))
            if(runif(1)<prob) X_new[ni,nj] <- 1
          }
        }
        # 生成远程火星
        if(ember){
          # 随机远程火点，距离 up to 3 格子
          r_ember <- sample(2:3, 1)
          ni <- i + r_ember * wind_dx
          nj <- j + r_ember * wind_dy
          if(ni>=1 && ni<=N && nj>=1 && nj<=N && X_new[ni,nj]==2){

          }
        }
        # 原火熄灭概率

scenarios <- c("No Ember", "With Ember")
df_all <- data.frame()
burned_summary <- data.frame()
all_burned_ratios <- data.frame()  # 用来存储每次模拟的烧毁比例

for(w in wind_strengths) {  # 对不同风力强度进行模拟
  for(scenario in scenarios){
    burned_ratios <- numeric(num_simulations)  # 存储每次模拟的烧毁比例

    for(sim in 1:num_simulations){  # 多次模拟
      X <- matrix(2, N, N)
      fire_indices <- expand.grid(x=(center-1):(center+1), y=(center-1):(center+1))
      for(k_idx in seq_len(nrow(fire_indices))) X[fire_indices$x[k_idx], fire_indices$y[k_idx]] <- 1

      for(t in 1:timesteps){
        X <- spread_fire(X, alpha, beta, w, wind_dx, wind_dy, ember=(scenario=="With Ember"))
      }

      # 记录每次模拟的烧毁比例
      burned_ratios[sim] <- sum(X == 0) / (N * N)

      # 只记录一次模拟结果（选取第一个模拟结果）
      if(sim == 1){
        df <- expand.grid(x=1:N, y=1:N)
        df$state <- as.factor(as.vector(X))
        df$scenario <- scenario
        df$wind_strength <- w  # 记录风力强度
        df_all <- rbind(df_all, df)
      }
    }

    # 计算每个场景的平均焚烧比例
    avg_burned_ratio <- mean(burned_ratios)
    burned_summary <- rbind(burned_summary, data.frame(scenario = scenario, wind_strength = w, burned = avg_burned_ratio))

    # 保存所有模拟的焚烧比例
    all_burned_ratios <- rbind(all_burned_ratios, data.frame(scenario = rep(scenario, num_simulations), wind_strength = w, burned = burned_ratios))
  }
}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# ----------------------------
# 参数设置
# ----------------------------
N <- 60
timesteps <- 7
alpha <- 0.3
beta <- 0.1
wind_strength <- 50
gamma <- 0.1
delta <- 0.05
max_wind_range <- 6
center <- N %/% 2
phi <- 0.3   # 消防概率
num_simulations <- 50  # 设置模拟次数

# 风向固定（东风）
wind_dx <- 1
wind_dy <- 0

# ----------------------------
# 生成邻居偏移函数（包含风向扩散范围）
# ----------------------------
generate_neighbors <- function(w, wind_dx, wind_dy){
  offsets <- expand.grid(dx=-1:1, dy=-1:1)
  offsets <- offsets[!(offsets$dx==0 & offsets$dy==0), ]
  r_max <- min(max_wind_range, 1 + ceiling(w/20))
  for(r in 2:r_max){
    offsets <- rbind(offsets, data.frame(dx=r*wind_dx, dy=r*wind_dy))
  }
  offsets
}

# ----------------------------
# 火灾传播函数（包含ember + 消防）
# ----------------------------
spread_fire_wind_firefighting <- function(X, alpha, beta, w, wind_dx, wind_dy, phi){
  N <- nrow(X)
  X_new <- X
  logit_alpha <- log(alpha/(1-alpha))
  neighbor_offsets <- generate_neighbors(w, wind_dx, wind_dy)
  
  for(i in 1:N){
    for(j in 1:N){
      if(X[i,j]==1){
        # 消防扑灭
        if(runif(1) < phi){
          X_new[i,j] <- 2
          next
        }
        for(n_idx in seq_len(nrow(neighbor_offsets))){
          ni <- i + neighbor_offsets$dx[n_idx]
          nj <- j + neighbor_offsets$dy[n_idx]
          if(ni>=1 && ni<=N && nj>=1 && nj<=N && X[ni,nj]==2){
            dx <- ni - i
            dy <- nj - j
            dot <- dx*wind_dx + dy*wind_dy
            norm <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2) * sqrt(wind_dx^2 + wind_dy^2)
            cos_theta <- if(norm==0) 0 else dot/norm
            prob <- 1/(1 + exp(-(logit_alpha + gamma*w*cos_theta + delta*w)))
            if(runif(1) < prob) X_new[ni,nj] <- 1
          }
        }
        if(runif(1) < beta) X_new[i,j] <- 0
      }
    }
  }
  X_new
}

# ----------------------------
# 模拟对比（控制变量，仅改变消防）
# ----------------------------
df_all <- data.frame()
burned_summary <- data.frame()
all_burned_ratios <- data.frame()  # 用来存储每次模拟的烧毁比例
scenarios <- c("No Firefighting", "With Firefighting")

for(scenario in scenarios){
  burned_ratios <- numeric(num_simulations)  # 存储每次模拟的烧毁比例
  
  for(sim in 1:num_simulations){  # 多次模拟
    X <- matrix(2, N, N)
    fire_indices <- expand.grid(x=(center-1):(center+1), y=(center-1):(center+1))
    for(k_idx in 1:nrow(fire_indices)) X[fire_indices$x[k_idx], fire_indices$y[k_idx]] <- 1
    
    for(t in 1:timesteps){
      if(scenario == "No Firefighting"){
        X <- spread_fire_wind_firefighting(X, alpha, beta, wind_strength, wind_dx, wind_dy, phi=0)
      } else {
        X <- spread_fire_wind_firefighting(X, alpha, beta, wind_strength, wind_dx, wind_dy, phi=phi)
      }
    }
    
    # 记录每次模拟的烧毁比例
    burned_ratios[sim] <- sum(X==0)/(N*N)
    
    # 只记录第一次模拟结果（选取第一个模拟结果）
    if(sim == 1){
      df <- expand.grid(x=1:N, y=1:N)
      df$state <- as.factor(as.vector(X))
      df$scenario <- scenario
      df_all <- rbind(df_all, df)
    }
  }
  
  # 计算每个场景的平均焚烧比例
  avg_burned_ratio <- mean(burned_ratios)
  burned_summary <- rbind(burned_summary, data.frame(scenario=scenario, burned=avg_burned_ratio))
  
  # 保存所有模拟的焚烧比例
  all_burned_ratios <- rbind(all_burned_ratios, data.frame(scenario=rep(scenario, num_simulations), burned=burned_ratios))
}
```

```{r}
for(w in wind_strengths){
  for(phi_val in phi_values){
    for(scenario in scenarios){
      burned_ratios <- numeric(num_simulations)  # 存储每次模拟的烧毁比例
      
      for(sim in 1:num_simulations){  # 多次模拟
        X <- matrix(2, N, N)
        fire_indices <- expand.grid(x=(center-1):(center+1), y=(center-1):(center+1))
        for(k_idx in 1:nrow(fire_indices)) X[fire_indices$x[k_idx], fire_indices$y[k_idx]] <- 1
        
        for(t in 1:timesteps){
          if(scenario == "No Firefighting"){
            X <- spread_fire_wind_firefighting(X, alpha, beta, w, wind_dx, wind_dy, phi=0)
          } else {
            X <- spread_fire_wind_firefighting(X, alpha, beta, w, wind_dx, wind_dy, phi=phi_val)
          }
        }
        
        # 记录每次模拟的烧毁比例
        burned_ratios[sim] <- sum(X==0)/(N*N)
        
        # 只记录第一次模拟结果（选取第一个模拟结果）
        if(sim == 1){
          df <- expand.grid(x=1:N, y=1:N)
          df$state <- as.factor(as.vector(X))
          df$scenario <- paste("Wind:", w, "- Phi:", phi_val, "-", scenario)
          df_all <- rbind(df_all, df)
        }
      }
      
      # 计算每个场景的平均焚烧比例
      avg_burned_ratio <- mean(burned_ratios)
      burned_summary <- rbind(burned_summary, data.frame(scenario=paste("Wind:", w, "- Phi:", phi_val, "-", scenario), burned=avg_burned_ratio))
      
      # 保存所有模拟的焚烧比例
      all_burned_ratios <- rbind(all_burned_ratios, data.frame(scenario=rep(paste("Wind:", w, "- Phi:", phi_val, "-", scenario), num_simulations), burned=burned_ratios))
    }
  }
}

# ----------------------------
# 使用 `RColorBrewer` 自动生成足够的颜色
# ----------------------------
colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Set1"))(18)  # 使用 `Set1` 调色板并扩展至 18 种颜色

# ----------------------------
# 条形图：烧毁面积对比
# ----------------------------
ggplot(burned_summary, aes(x=scenario, y=burned, fill=scenario)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", color="black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=colors) +  # 使用扩展的颜色
  labs(title="Burned Area Ratio (Firefighting Effect with Wind and Firefighting Probabilities)",
       x="Scenario", y="Burned Ratio") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))

# ----------------------------
# 箱型图：展示每个场景下焚烧比例的分布
# ----------------------------
ggplot(all_burned_ratios, aes(x=factor(scenario), y=burned, fill=factor(scenario))) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = "red", outlier.size = 2) +  # 高亮显示异常值
  scale_fill_manual(values=colors) +  # 使用扩展的颜色
  labs(title="Burned Area Distribution by Scenario",
       x="Scenario", y="Burned Ratio") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12), axis.title=element_text(size=14),
        strip.text=element_text(size=12), legend.position="none")

# ----------------------------
# 折线图：展示每个场景下每次模拟的焚烧比例
# ----------------------------
ggplot(all_burned_ratios, aes(x=seq_along(burned), y=burned, group=scenario, color=factor(scenario))) +
  geom_line(alpha=0.5) +
  labs(title="Burned Area per Simulation vs Scenario",
       x="Simulation Number", y="Burned Ratio") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values=colors) +  # 使用扩展的颜色
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=12), axis.title=element_text(size=14))

# ----------------------------
# 保存数据
# ----------------------------
burned_summary_fire <- burned_summary
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# ----------------------------
# 参数设置
# ----------------------------
N <- 60
timesteps <- 7
alpha_values <- c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6)  # 不同的 alpha 参数
beta_values <- c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5)  # 不同的 beta 参数
wind_strength_values <- c(10, 40, 70)  # 不同的风力强度
phi_values <- c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5)  # 不同的消防概率
gamma <- 0.1
delta <- 0.05
max_wind_range <- 6
center <- N %/% 2
num_simulations <- 50  # 设置模拟次数

# 风向固定（东风）
wind_dx <- 1
wind_dy <- 0

# ----------------------------
# 生成邻居偏移函数（包含风向扩散范围）
# ----------------------------
generate_neighbors <- function(w, wind_dx, wind_dy){
  offsets <- expand.grid(dx=-1:1, dy=-1:1)
  offsets <- offsets[!(offsets$dx==0 & offsets$dy==0), ]
  r_max <- min(max_wind_range, 1 + ceiling(w/20))
  for(r in 2:r_max){
    offsets <- rbind(offsets, data.frame(dx=r*wind_dx, dy=r*wind_dy))
  }
  offsets
}

# ----------------------------
# 火灾传播函数（包含ember + 消防）
# ----------------------------
spread_fire_wind_firefighting <- function(X, alpha, beta, w, wind_dx, wind_dy, phi){
  N <- nrow(X)
  X_new <- X
  logit_alpha <- log(alpha/(1-alpha))
  neighbor_offsets <- generate_neighbors(w, wind_dx, wind_dy)
  
  for(i in 1:N){
    for(j in 1:N){
      if(X[i,j]==1){
        # 消防扑灭
        if(runif(1) < phi){
          X_new[i,j] <- 2
          next
        }
        for(n_idx in seq_len(nrow(neighbor_offsets))){
          ni <- i + neighbor_offsets$dx[n_idx]
          nj <- j + neighbor_offsets$dy[n_idx]
          if(ni>=1 && ni<=N && nj>=1 && nj<=N && X[ni,nj]==2){
            dx <- ni - i
            dy <- nj - j
            dot <- dx*wind_dx + dy*wind_dy
            norm <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2) * sqrt(wind_dx^2 + wind_dy^2)
            cos_theta <- if(norm==0) 0 else dot/norm
            prob <- 1/(1 + exp(-(logit_alpha + gamma*w*cos_theta + delta*w)))
            if(runif(1) < prob) X_new[ni,nj] <- 1
          }
        }
        if(runif(1) < beta) X_new[i,j] <- 0
      }
    }
  }
  X_new
}

# ----------------------------
# 模拟对比（控制变量，改变多组参数）
# ----------------------------
result_data <- data.frame()  # 用于存储每次模拟结果

# 创建不同组合的场景
param_combinations <- expand.grid(alpha=alpha_values, beta=beta_values, 
                                  wind_strength=wind_strength_values, phi=phi_values)

for(i in 1:nrow(param_combinations)){
  params <- param_combinations[i,]
  alpha <- params$alpha
  beta <- params$beta
  wind_strength <- params$wind_strength
  phi <- params$phi
  
  burned_ratios <- numeric(num_simulations)  # 存储每次模拟的烧毁比例
  
  for(sim in 1:num_simulations){  # 多次模拟
    X <- matrix(2, N, N)
    fire_indices <- expand.grid(x=(center-1):(center+1), y=(center-1):(center+1))
    for(k_idx in 1:nrow(fire_indices)) X[fire_indices$x[k_idx], fire_indices$y[k_idx]] <- 1
    
    for(t in 1:timesteps){
      X <- spread_fire_wind_firefighting(X, alpha, beta, wind_strength, wind_dx, wind_dy, phi)
    }
    
    # 记录每次模拟的烧毁比例
    burned_ratios[sim] <- sum(X==0)/(N*N)
  }
  
  # 将每组参数组合与对应的烧毁比汇总到结果数据框中
  result_data <- rbind(result_data, data.frame(
    alpha=alpha,
    beta=beta,
    wind_strength=wind_strength,
    phi=phi,
    burned_ratio=mean(burned_ratios)
  ))
}

# ----------------------------
# 根据烧毁比从高到低排序
# ----------------------------
result_data_sorted <- result_data[order(-result_data$burned_ratio), ]

# ----------------------------
# 在 R 中显示排序后的结果
# ----------------------------
print(result_data_sorted)

# ----------------------------
# 将排序后的结果储存为变量
# ----------------------------
burned_ratio_data_sorted <- result_data_sorted

```

```{r}
# 多元线性回归
model <- lm(burned_ratio ~ alpha + beta + wind_strength + phi, data = burned_ratio_data_sorted)

# 输出回归结果
summary(model)

```

```{r}
# 残差提取
residuals <- residuals(model)

# 绘制 Q-Q 图
qqnorm(residuals)
qqline(residuals, col = "red")  # 添加参考线

# 正态性检验（Shapiro-Wilk 检验）
shapiro.test(residuals)

```

```{r}
# 拟合值
fitted_values <- fitted(model)

# 绘制残差 vs 拟合值图
plot(fitted_values, residuals, 
     main = "Residuals vs Fitted Values", 
     xlab = "Fitted Values", 
     ylab = "Residuals")
abline(h = 0, col = "red")

```

```{r}
library(betareg)

# 缩放比例，避免0/1
n <- nrow(burned_ratio_data_sorted)
burned_ratio_data_sorted$burned_ratio_scaled <- 
  (burned_ratio_data_sorted$burned_ratio * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n

# Beta 回归
model_beta <- betareg(burned_ratio_scaled ~ alpha + beta + wind_strength + phi,
                      data = burned_ratio_data_sorted)

summary(model_beta)

# 残差图
res <- residuals(model_beta, type="pearson")
plot(fitted(model_beta), res, xlab="Fitted", ylab="Residuals")
abline(h=0,col="red")
```
